name: Autumn Cartel
summary: Adds a warehouse district, black-market rifle set, and amber seasonal lighting pass.

name: Winter Freezeout
summary: Introduces a snowbound port map, frosted vehicle skins, and icy handling tuning.

name: Rustbelt Space
summary: Builds a red-dust rustbelt district on a Mars colony with scavenger convoys, pressurized refinery yards, and outlaw gun caches hidden inside collapsed habitation blocks.

name: Venus Space Homes
season: Venus home corridors and ship landings, ship dealerships
summary: Opens a luxury-survival colony on Venus with stacked residential corridors, neon docking towers, ship dealerships, climate-sealed plazas, and black-market firefights beneath stormproof transit rails.

name: Radio Warriors
season: People lost communication leaving Venus to go back and explore mars and they have to create and rebuild a radio tower and find a radio to communicate back and fourth from venus to mars
summary: Follows stranded runners who lose long-range contact between Venus and Mars and must recover field radios, rebuild a shattered relay tower, defend broadcast stations, and reopen off-world communication routes across hostile frontier zones.
